title: A CPU-Only Framework for Mining Collectively-Behaving Bots in MMORPGs
abstract: arXiv:2611.30502v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: MMORPGs continually face automated programs (bots) that disrupt gameplay balance and in-game economies. An unsupervised Transformer framework can mine collectively behaving bot groups, but its multi-GPU training is costly in live operations. We show that such GPU-trained sequence models are not strictly necessary for this task. Our CPU pipeline pairs zone embeddings learned from movement context, which place teleport-linked zones close together, with a training-free coordinate kernel, and then applies density clustering. It trains 3-5$\times$ faster than the GPU-based Transformer (56-86$\times$ on the same CPU) while matching its mining quality on two commercial MMORPGs, and has been deployed since late 2024. We also share deployment lessons on how to set the clustering threshold and when to retrain.

translated_title: 一种仅使用CPU的框架，用于挖掘MMORPG中集体行为的外挂机器人
translated_abstract: 大型多人在线角色扮演游戏持续面临破坏游戏玩法平衡和游戏内经济的自动化程序（外挂机器人）的困扰。一种无监督Transformer框架能够挖掘集体行为的外挂机器人群体，但其多GPU训练在实际运营中成本高昂。我们证明此类GPU训练的序列模型对于该任务并非严格必需。我们的CPU流水线将从移动上下文中学到的区域嵌入（该嵌入将存在传送关联的区域放置在相近位置）与无需训练的坐标核相结合，然后应用密度聚类。在两款商业MMORPG上，其训练速度比基于GPU的Transformer快3-5倍（在同一CPU上快56-86倍），同时达到与其相当的挖掘质量，并且自2024年底以来已部署上线。我们还分享了关于如何设置聚类阈值以及何时重新训练的部署经验。
tldr: 提出一种仅用CPU的无监督框架，结合从移动上下文学习的区域嵌入、免训练坐标核与密度聚类来挖掘MMORPG中集体行为的外挂机器人，训练速度比GPU Transformer快3-5倍且挖掘质量相当，已于2024年底实际部署。
en_tdlr: A CPU-only unsupervised framework that pairs movement-context zone embeddings with a training-free coordinate kernel and density clustering mines collectively-behaving bots in MMORPGs, training 3-5× faster than a GPU-based Transformer while matching its quality, and has been deployed since late 2024.
